stage0006_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「Good... the Federation's here.
　Everything's going as planned.」

stage0006_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オットー$$
「I knew it, Neo Zeon...!」

stage0006_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Judging by their unit composition,
　it's likely not the unit we were pursuing.」

stage0006_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オットー$$
「True enough.
　Their main force is outdated, past its prime.」

stage0006_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$オットー$$
「This alone isn't enough to call it
　an armed uprising by Neo Zeon.」

stage0006_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Moreover, that they were positioned to intercept us
　seems unnatural as well...」

stage0006_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$レイアム$$
「They show no sign of heeding our cease-fire warning.
　What are your orders, Captain?」

stage0006_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$オットー$$
「We'll get the XO's answers by squeezing them.
　Signal all units to attack.」

stage0006_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It really is strange.
　Practically begging us to find them
　with actions like this...」

stage0006_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$リディ$$
「Maybe they couldn't shake our pursuit and gave up?」

stage0006_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$クルツ$$
「If that's the case, as they wish,
　let's wrap this up quick, huh?」

stage0006_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$マオ$$
「Watch yourself.
　If they really are Neo Zeon,
　their resolve won't be run-of-the-mill.」

stage0006_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$n
「I don't know their goal,
　and I hold no personal anger or grudge,
　but this is the mission.」

stage0006_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$n
「I intend to avoid the cockpit as much as possible.
　Miss $$スズネ$$, please navigate with that in mind.」

stage0006_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Skull Leader to all units!
　We don't know the enemy's next move, stay sharp!」

stage0006_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$オズマ$$
「To break their coordination too,
　take out the enemy teams in parallel!」

stage0006_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「New mobile suit group approaching, confirmed!
　Here they come!」

stage0006_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$オットー$$
「A Neo Zeon $$ギラ・ドーガ$$!」

stage0006_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$レイアム$$
「This should leave Neo Zeon with no room to deny it.」

stage0006_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ボビー$$
「So, is a war about to start!?」

stage0006_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「It all depends on how Neo Zeon reacts
　when we confront them with this.」

stage0006_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...He likes convoluted methods.
　Thanks to that, I had to come all the way to Earth.」

stage0006_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「But if I'm facing that $$ネェル・アーガマ$$,
　that changes things.」

stage0006_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This feeling...!
　That lead custom unit's for Enhanced Humans...!」

stage0006_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$カミーユ・ビダン$$...!
　If you can feel my pressure,
　then you'll be my opponent!」

stage0006_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain, it looks like Neo Zeon is making a move.
　What are your orders?」

stage0006_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$オットー$$
「Naturally, we intercept!
　That's our duty!」

stage0006_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Here I come, Londo Bell!
　I'll show you the power of $$ギュネイ・ガス$$!」

stage0006_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The enemy's core unit appears to be that horned one.」

stage0006_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$オットー$$
「I can tell that much just by looking...!」

stage0006_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Not much to you, Londo Bell!
　Seems the Colonel's worries were needless!」

stage0006_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「A missile...!?
　Where did that come from!」

stage0006_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it!
　A submarine, of all things!」

stage0006_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「It seems there was no direct hit on the target.」

stage0006_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's enough if it slows them down.
　The Danaan will cover the strike force from here.」

stage0006_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye aye, ma'am.
　I'll pass the word to all hands.」

stage0006_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's our mother ship...
　Attached to $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet,
　the assault landing submarine $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0006_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$甲児$$
「Tu... tu... what did you say?」

stage0006_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$n
「$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.
　Named after Celtic mythology, then.」

stage0006_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$さやか$$
「$n, you really know a lot about that stuff.」

stage0006_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$マオ$$
「If you can't remember it, just call it the Danaan.」

stage0006_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thanks, $$テッサ$$!
　Now the tables have turned!」

stage0006_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of the Colonel...
　A precise assist.」

stage0006_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オットー$$
「So that's the $$ミスリル$$ the commander told us about.」

stage0006_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Just as rumored, their gear seems a decade ahead.」

stage0006_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$オットー$$
「But we're Londo Bell too.
　We can't afford to lose...!」

stage0006_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$オットー$$
「All units, go on the offensive!
　Push them back in one go!」

stage0006_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy force is wiped out.
　No reinforcements in sight, either.」

stage0006_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then let's leave the rest to them and pull back.」

stage0006_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「After this, we still need to visit that research lab.」

stage0006_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am.
　Diving now.」

stage0006_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Huh... not even a goodbye to us?」

stage0006_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$マオ$$
「Can't be helped.
　The fact they sent us on loan to the Quarter
　means the Danaan's got its own op running.」

stage0006_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Since we had the chance, I wanted a good look
　at $$ミスリル$$'s submarine.」

stage0006_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　I've never really seen a submarine up close either.」

stage0006_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That day will come eventually.
　When it does, you're welcome aboard.」

stage0006_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$マオ$$
（And they'll be surprised too,
　when they see our Colonel.）

stage0006_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$キャシー$$
「...I wonder if this incident will become
　a decisive rift between Earth and Space...」

stage0006_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Who knows...
　At this scale, Neo Zeon
　can make all the excuses they want.」

stage0006_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「What they want to know, in turn,
　is how the Earth Federation will respond.」

stage0006_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hm...
　Perhaps the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and we
　were made to play along with Neo Zeon's provocation...」

stage0006_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Tch...!
　This gravity, I still can't get used to it!」

stage0006_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Whatever.
　The objective's met, so that's it for today.
　The real fight starts next time.」

stage0006_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That guy... why does he know about me...?」

stage0006_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What is this... this unease keeps growing...）

stage0006_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That feeling...
　That guy's an Enhanced Human...」

stage0006_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$エマ$$
「So Neo Zeon has Enhanced Humans ready too.」

stage0006_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（What is this uneasy feeling...
　This unease keeps growing...）

stage0006_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Good teamwork.
　Our daily training is paying off.」

stage0006_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カナリア$$
「It's not like we've been trained by
　'Demon' $$オズマ$$ for nothing.」

stage0006_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「A $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ pilot!
　So you're $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

stage0006_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This guy...!
　He knows who I am!?」

stage0006_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Bad luck for you!
　I'll prove my strength by taking you down!」

stage0006_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I've no time for your selfish logic!
　War isn't a game!」

stage0006_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn Valkyries!
　Flitting about so smugly!」

stage0006_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know who you are,
　but if you start it, don't cry when you lose!」

stage0006_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Don't make me laugh!
　Don't think the likes of you can beat me!」

stage0006_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So the $$ミスリル$$ I've heard rumors of
　is running joint ops with the Earth Federation!」

stage0006_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「What's wrong...!
　Too frightened by my pressure to speak!」

stage0006_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have never met a soldier who wastes words in battle.
　Because that kind of soldier dies quickly.」

stage0006_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「This guy...!
　Trying to make me angry!」

stage0006_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$n
「That guy... compared to anyone I've fought,
　his movement and reactions are totally different...!」

stage0006_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course!
　Because you're facing a Newtype!」

stage0006_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$n
「I don't care what label you carry.」

stage0006_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$n
「Whoever I'm up against,
　I just fight the enemy in front of me!」

stage0006_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Londo Bell, $$ミスリル$$,
　Frontier fleet's $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, and Super Robots...
　No shortage of worthy opponents!」

stage0006_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Watch closely...!
　I'll show them all just what I can do!」

stage0006_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Confirm the target, then eliminate it swiftly.」

stage0006_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am...!
　Commence attack!」

stage0006_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Melissa, Weber... and Sergeant Sagara.
　Soon, I'll release you all from that duty.）
